description: This file defines the PHP class EmployeeClaimRequestSearchFilterParams in the namespace OrangeHRM\Claim\Dto. The class extends ClaimRequestSearchFilterParams and specifies a list of allowed sort fields related to claim request filtering in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeClaimRequestSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object class used to encapsulate search filter parameters for employee claim requests, extending the base ClaimRequestSearchFilterParams class.
